stderr:
mancer-mcp: --config is required

usage: mancer-mcp --config <caps.json> [--env-file <wallet.env>]

  --config     the caps file (JSON): the mode, the caps, the tokens, the recipients
  --env-file   MANCER_MCP_PRIVATE_KEY=0x… (the wallet), and optionally MANCER_API_KEY and MANCER_RPC_URL;
               chmod 600. Without it the server reads Mancer and acts on nothing.
